title: Ịzụlite azụmahịa: nnukwu iwu, ịkwụ ụgwọ ziri ezi na atụmatụ ụbọchị 90 gị
course_title: Njikwa Azụmaahịa Ejiji: Ọrụ Mmepụta maka Scaling

say: Ịzụlite azụmahịa: nnukwu iwu, ịkwụ ụgwọ ziri ezi na atụmatụ ụbọchị 90 gị.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul 3 nke Njikwa Azụmaahịa Ejiji.
Boutiques, ụlọ akwụkwọ, ụlọ ọrụ na ụdị ndị ọzọ na-eweta olu. Ha na-arịọkwa maka ọnụ ahịa dị ala, ogologo oge ịkwụ ụgwọ na oge njedebe siri ike. Yabụ na ị ga-ebu ụzọ nwalee onyinye ọ bụla.

say: Site na mbufe, ha na-akwụ gị ụgwọ naanị maka ihe erere, yabụ ngwaahịa gị na ego gị chere na shelf ha. Malite boutiques ọhụrụ obere, wee bugharịa ezigbo ndị mmekọ na nnukwu iwu.

say: Otu boutique na-enye Adaeze puku naira iri na otu maka peplum top iri atọ, a na-akwụ ya ụbọchị iri isii ka e nyechara ya. Onye ọ bụla n'elu na-akwụ ya puku naira asaa na iri isii na asatọ. Ọnụahịa ahụ na-arụ ọrụ, na-enweta uru 3,532 naira kwa elu.

panel.heading: Ọnụ, ego, ikike
items: Ọnụ: ọnụ ahịa ọ dị karịa mkpokọta ọnụ ahịa gị?
Ego nkịtị: kedu ihe ị na-emefu tupu a kwụọ gị ụgwọ?
Ike: nkeji oge ọ dabara oge ohere gị?

say: Mana ọ ga-ebu ụzọ were ihe dị puku naira 188,400 wee chere ụbọchị iri isii. Ego bụ nsogbu. Ya mere, ọ na-arịọ ka e nye ya 50% nkwụnye ego nke 165,000 naira, na-akwụ naanị 23,400 n'onwe ya.

say: N'elu chọrọ nkeji 1,650, nke ọma n'ime nkeji 6,020 mapụtara ya.

say: Ndị aghụghọ na-ezipụ ọkwa mbufe adịgboroja yana nnukwu iwu adịgboroja. Kwado nkwụnye ego ọ bụla n'ime ụlọ akụ ma ọ bụ ngwa ịkwụ ụgwọ tupu ibelata, na akwụla ụgwọ iji nweta iwu.

panel.rule: Kwenye ego n'ime ngwa ụlọ akụ nke gị, ọ bụghị site na nseta ihuenyo.

say: Nnukwu nkwekọrịta bụ ebe ụlọ ọrụ na-adakarị ada, n'ihi na onye nwe ya na-ekwu ee tupu ịlele nkeji. Otu ụlọ akwụkwọ na-arịọ 200 pinafores. Nke ọ bụla na-ewe nkeji iri anọ, yabụ nkeji 8,000.

panel.heading: 200 ụlọ akwụkwọ pinafores n'ime otu ọnwa

Naanị nkeji 6,020 nwere ohere
Kewara: 150 ugbu a, 50 na mmalite nke ọnwa 2

say: Adaeze nwere naanị nkeji 6,020 mapụtara n'ọnwa na-abịa.

say: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ mpempe akwụkwọ dị obere, ndị ọrụ na-agba ọsọ na ịdịmma na-ata ahụhụ. Ya mere wuo ya site na nkeji oge.
Ebumnuche Adaeze maka onye ọrụ a zụrụ azụ bụ puku naira 3,600 maka ụbọchị awa asatọ. Lelee na ọ dịghị n'okpuru ụgwọ opekempe nke mba ugbu a maka otu ọnwa.

say: Ọtụtụ ụlọ ọrụ na-ejikọta abụọ ahụ. Ntọala a kapịrị ọnụ na-eme ka onye ọrụ kwụsie ike n'ime ọnwa nwayọ, yana obere ego na-akwụghachi ụgwọ dị mma karịa ebumnuche.

card.title: A base plus a quality bonus

say: Ebe ahụ bụ puku naira iri isii kwa ọnwa.

card.title: A base plus a quality bonus

say: Ọ na-eme iberibe 780 dị mma, 180 karịa ihe a tụrụ anya 600. Na naira 60 nke ọ bụla, ego ya bụ 10,800.

card.title: A base plus a quality bonus

say: Ya mere ọ na-enweta puku naira iri asaa na asatọ. Onye ọrụ n'okpuru ebumnuche na-enweta ntọala na nkuzi, ọ bụghị mwepu.
Dee usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ, awa, oge ngafe, okpu na mwepu akwa na oge ọkwa n'ime nkwekọrịta mbinye aka.

card.title: A base plus a quality bonus

say: Kwa ọnwa, soro nnyefe n'oge yana ọnụego ntụpọ gị. Adaeze nyere 187 n'ime 210 n'oge, na ntụpọ ya dara site na 15% ruo 8%.

say: Icheta. Nwalee onyinye ọ bụla na ọnụ ahịa, ego na ikike, wee rịọ maka nkwụnye ego na-ekpuchi ihe. Kewaa ma ọ bụ jụ nkwekọrịta karịrị nkeji oge mapụtara gị. Mepụta ọnụego mpempe akwụkwọ site na nkeji ọkọlọtọ.
Na goro onye ọrụ igwe ọzọ naanị mgbe erere nkeji ndị ọzọ.

say: Nwalee otu ezigbo onyinye wee dee usoro gị. Mepụta ọnụego mpempe akwụkwọ ma depụta nkwekọrịta ndị ọrụ. Dejupụta dashboard gị, wee dee atụmatụ ụbọchị 90 nwere omume atọ kwa ọnwa, nke ọ bụla nwere onye nwe ya na ụbọchị.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
